stemMd: For f(x)=5−2x, which value of x makes f(x)=0?
explanationMd: Set 5−2x=0, so 2x=5 and x=5/2. Substitution gives 5−5=0, confirming the root.

distractorRationale.a: This ignores the coefficient of x.
distractorRationale.e: This moves the constant with the wrong sign.
distractorRationale.c: This uses the slope instead of the root.
